description: This Python module provides utilities for detecting 'pacing' events based on spatial zones and temporal constraints. It includes polygon definitions for zones, coordinate calculations from bounding boxes, point-in-polygon operations, and logic to identify pacing starts, continues, and stops in detection data streams. It primarily supports batch and streaming detection of pacing events, with configurable zones and detection parameters.

classes.description: A dataclass representing a detected pacing event, including type (START/CONTINUE/STOP), timestamp, and anchor zone.
